title: The Pillow Court Signature Reverie
summary: The signature reverie of the pillow court that smothers a foe's will under heavy soft dream and rests the court's own.

title: The Azure Dreamer's Signature Rite
summary: A rite of the azure dreamers who lift a whole field of minds into one wide blue dream and move through it unseen.

title: The Basin of Boundless Sleep
summary: A deep book in which the Core is a basin of sleep with no floor that the dreamer tips out over a whole battlefield.

title: The Wind-Sworn Sleeper's Oath
summary: The signature oath of the wind-sworn dreamers who swear to keep every sleeper safe and put every threat to sleep in turn.

title: The Hushed Sky Rite
summary: A rite in which a whole sky of dream force is hushed to stillness and every moving thing beneath it slows.

title: The Dream Beyond the Bearing
summary: A far-reaching book of the dream that takes a foe off every bearing until the foe cannot find the way back to waking.
